dag_claims.statement: For valid interpreted graph, let r=c-Dphi, D^T y=0, |y|<=w. For any psi, y^T c=y^T(c-Dpsi)<=sum w|c-Dpsi|. A checked feasible phi with equal primal and dual objectives is therefore globally optimal. This implication requires weak duality only, not trusting the simplex producer or assuming strong duality. Potential checker repeats this core and additionally checks fundamental cycle residuals using the reference graph helper.

H0 completeness needs kernel membership plus independence plus dimC0-rankD cardinality. H1 basis requires rank[D|B]=dimC1 and |B|=dimC1-rankD. Gluing Dx=b is direct; nonzero eta^T b with D^T eta=0 proves inconsistency. Checker2 independently recomputes rank and target augmented rank, while checker1 misses H0 cardinality completeness. Combined gate rejects the reproduced incomplete H0 witness.

For valid finite free chain complex, integer U,Uinv,V,Vinv with inverse identities and U*d*V diagonal with positive divisibility chain certify cokernel invariant factors. Since ker(d_n) is saturated in free C_n (quotient is im(d_n), free), torsion of C_n/im(d_{n+1}) equals torsion H_n. Betti follows rank-nullity. Checker2 recomputes integer invariant factors and field2 ranks; mere Euler equality or F2 inequality would not determine torsion.

For D1D0=0 and positive diagonalW, imD0 and im(W^-1D1^T) are W-orthogonal. A decomposition with harmonic h in both kernels is unique by positive definiteness. Exact harmonic membership, independence and cardinality E-rankD0-rankD1 establish basis completeness. Checker1 implements these; checker2 compares uniquely recomputed normal-equation parts but does not inspect harmonic_basis.

For a valid filtered simplicial boundary over F2, upper-unitriangular V preserves the filtration, R=DV changes basis, and unique nonzero column lows yield persistence pairings. Zero R columns not paired as lows give essential classes. Checker2 independently reduces D by sparse XOR. Equal filtration-value births/deaths are retained as index pairs but omitted from value barcodes.

A closed product with nonzero pairing against a closed cycle is nonexact. The finite functional modules construct all19 retention,20 functional and19 self-reference Boolean signatures for their explicitly defined predicates. Necessity comes from elementary map/equality implications and sufficiency from explicit models with at most four states. Implication enumeration is complete within those predicate classes, not evidence about consciousness or an unrestricted empirical system. In particular, self-reference linkage is checked against declared generation tables and successful report plans consume already supplied target values.

FiniteWordTransducer performs an exact all-finite-word descent check through reachable product states, conditional on a supplied finite total memory and transducer; generic history callbacks are outside that guarantee. Separately, the FD owner computes finite attribute closure, projected FD implications, BCNF violations, dependency preservation and the binary lossless-join criterion under FD-only constraints. Instance-level exact joins and successful samples remain distinct from universal schema claims.

The repository contains two opposite operations on finite observational equivalences: report repair adds distinctions until the old report and all supplied answers factor, whereas ContextReflection merges distinctions until the equivalence becomes stable under actions. The latter has an identity-carrier universal factorization but can lose original information. Arbitrary comparison retention instead computes a greatest stable relation and must separately check equivalence and literal-report descent. None of these operations discovers missing truthful answers by itself.

Finite simulations preserve explicit report/transition tables, with Exact mode reflecting availability and ResourceExtension recording added availability. State-relative swaps require both orders enabled and future-equivalent endpoints. Finite trace components enumerate the complete reachable permutation class under those certified swaps, with a stricter exact-state option. This provides a possible mathematical discipline for comparing declared workflow reorderings, but does not license arbitrary permutations or establish LLM semantic equivalence.

FinitePartialStructure provides exact descent of many-sorted partial operations and predicates through surjective sort maps, including reflection of unavailability and falsity. FinitePathCategory completely enumerates a finite acyclic multigraph free category before canonical category validation. JointDynamics requires local transitions to preserve an explicitly admitted relation and refines paired local behavior reports when supplied joint interactions distinguish them. These are substantive finite constructions with explicit premises, not general physical composition theorems.

The finite report modules implement substantive exact finite mathematics: a query factors through a report precisely when it is constant on every report fiber; failure has a two-point collision witness. Answer-profile quotients supply common refinements, and operation descent also requires availability to be constant on fibers. Explicit joint relations avoid assuming all locally available pairs exist. The presheaf owner validates actual restriction laws and distinguishes no global extension, unique gluing and ambiguous gluing for a finite cover. This does not certify natural-language report adequacy or physical realization.

FiniteMoore implements the coarsest report-respecting transition congruence by exact finite partition refinement, with a replayable canonical chain and surjective-morphism factorization. PartialDynamics completes missing transitions with a distinct absorbing sink and supplies bounded shortest distinguishing-word search. These are finite behavioral equivalence results for a supplied complete transition/observation model; exhausted search is refusal and no physical completeness or general LLM semantic equivalence follows.

DaggerStructure validates an actual finite category followed by involutive contravariant identity/composition laws. FiniteGroupoid additionally requires every dagger to be a two-sided inverse and constructs component/isotropy coordinates. For the separately admitted complex groupoid algebra, these coordinates give matrix algebras over isotropy group algebras; nonzero simplicity is equivalent to one connected component with trivial isotropy. This conditional algebraic statement does not derive complex scalars or quantum mechanics.

CounterReport implements a finite-depth future-legality quotient for a nonnegative counter: at remaining depth r, min(n,r) determines every guarded continuation of length at most r, with depth reduced after each event. Distinct clips are separated by a bounded decrement word. The arrow combinators separately implement sequential Reader/State/Writer/Result-style composition; fanout shares sequential state and is not isolated concurrent agent execution.
